call_chain: Pinned src/gba/core.c registers _GBACoreLoadSave as core->loadSave; the harness verifies this registration but invokes the extracted callback directly.
GBALoadSave preserves a host-seeded SRAM type, initializes savedata with the supplied VFile, then dispatches GBASavedataForceType.
GBASavedataInitSRAM queries the one-byte fixture size, calls the void VFile truncate operation, maps the target 32 KiB range, then fills from the old EOF with 0xFF.
The original POSIX VFile FD implementation calls ftruncate and discards its result.

host_fixture_stubs: GBA hardware cleanup not involved in GBAUnloadROM
GBASavedataLoad unreachable when realVf equals vf
flash, EEPROM, SRAM512 initialization unreachable for the seeded SRAM case
execution.ftruncate_fault: Linker-wrapped EIO and ENOSPC injected before the real syscall.

local_validation.source_mode: Exact pinned individual source files fetched to /tmp; not a git checkout.

execution.failure_observation: The failed truncate leaves the one-byte backing file short; the original shared mapping's fill reaches the next page and raises SIGBUS in the isolated child.
execution.recovery: A separate loadSave invocation after removing injection succeeds; no automatic retry is claimed.
execution.production_cleanup: Original GBAUnloadROM is called only after successful initialization; fault child process exit reclaims resources.
native_filesystem_syscalls: ftruncate (faulted by wrapper or called normally)

limitations: Source files and selected function bodies are pinned and hash-checked; this is not whole-file semantic review.
The harness seeds SRAM type instead of executing natural core initialization, SRAM autodetection, or GBAMemoryWrite8 caller reachability.
The ftruncate errors are injected; this does not demonstrate a natural filesystem/storage failure.
SIGBUS is a Linux host observation under this controlled one-byte-file and shared-mapping fixture, not evidence of user-visible save corruption.
The full mGBA core, frontend, actual user save, durable .sav persistence, stock gameplay, and physical Flash are not tested.
Receipt remains non-approving; independent source semantic review and all broader Phase 1 gate requirements remain outstanding.
